description: Single jet trainer on a tiered circular kerbed plinth in the centre of the Air Force Roundabout, on the public road outside the Air Force Military School Jos. Identified as NAF420 construction number 491015 by the Spottingmode location record at 9.87101N 8.88660E, seven metres from the plinth centre. Still in place in Google satellite imagery of 2026, where the planform measures roughly 11-12 m in both span and length, consistent with the L-29 at 10.29 m span and 10.81 m length and inconsistent with any larger twin; the wingtip tanks read as engine nacelles from directly overhead. NAF4xx is the Nigerian Air Force L-29 serial block - NAF409 construction number 993330 is a second preserved L-29 at Kano - while the L-39ZA block is NAF3xx. Serial and construction number rest on that single entry; no ground photograph was found.
